segments.en: The essential coming of the person into this world — is specifically to clarify the truth from the falsehood. For this is the essential wholeness of the truth — when it is clarified from within the darkness of the falsehood. In the end of ends the truth will be revealed before all eyes. Until all the glory will be with the truth. For "the lip of truth will endure forever" [Proverbs 12:19]. And then certainly all will run to serve Hashem in truth — and to draw close to the true Tzadik.
Truth and falsehood are the aspects of light and darkness.
